verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own marketing describes built-in AI features: an AI code reviewer that suggests fixes, pipeline-triggered AI workflows that handle chores like cleaning up feature flags, updating docs, drafting release notes and fixing flaky tests, and AI-powered chat, pipeline triage and Jira updates. Rovo models are also available in the terminal and IDE. This shows real first-party AI task automation, but the evidence is only one-line marketing claims, and the delegation shown is pipeline-configured rather than interactive. missing for 10: evidence that the in-product chat assistant can be handed tasks and carry them out, documentation of how delegation works and its limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
